item.title: West Norfolk residents honoured for wildlife-friendly gardens
item.description:
📰 FENLAND ANGELS RADIO | LOCAL NEWS
West Norfolk residents honoured for wildlife-friendly gardens
West Norfolk Council has announced the winners of its second annual Garden Wildlife Competition. A ceremony held at King’s Lynn Town Hall on Tuesday celebrated residents who have transformed their outdoor spaces into havens for nature. The contest, which aims to support biodiversity, attracted 36 entries across large and small garden categories.
Winners included gardeners from Lynn, Southery, West Dereham, Great Bircham, and Downham Market. Mayor Steve Bearshaw and Councillor Michael de Whalley presented the awards, highlighting the positive impact these local habitats have on the environment. The event also featured presentations on nature recovery and the importance of supporting pollinators, encouraging further community involvement in the council’s wider biodiversity efforts.

item.description:

Volunteers help prepare new King’s Lynn charity shop
A team of seven volunteers from the Lloyds relationship management department in King’s Lynn has helped prepare a new store for the Caring Together charity. The group spent time painting the stock room at the former Cancer Research UK premises on the High Street.
The shop is scheduled to open this autumn to support unpaid carers across Norfolk, Cambridgeshire, and Peterborough. Shop manager Belinda Jones is now calling for more local people to join the team as the site prepares to become a community hub. Anyone interested in volunteering on the shop floor or in the stock room can contact the charity via email at shop.volunteers@caringtogether.org.

item.title: Norfolk Police trial new drone technology in King’s Lynn
item.description:
📰 FENLAND ANGELS RADIO | LOCAL NEWS
Norfolk Police trial new drone technology in King’s Lynn
Norfolk Constabulary has launched a five-week trial of new "Drone as First Responder" technology. The initiative, which began on September 7, aims to provide officers with live aerial views of incidents to help direct resources more effectively. King’s Lynn is one of four areas involved in the trial, alongside Norwich, Thetford, and Great Yarmouth.
Specially trained officers will remotely pilot the drones to assist with tasks such as locating missing people, tracking suspects, and assessing developing situations. The force has confirmed that all flights will operate under strict legal frameworks and oversight. Following the trial, police will review the results to determine the potential benefits of integrating this technology into their long-term policing operations.
🔗 More details: https://www.lynnnews.co.uk/news/police-trial-new-drone-first-responder-technology-in-town-9483391/

The Lynn Priory Satellite Rotary Club is calling for participants to join its second annual charity firewalk. The event takes place on Friday, October 2, at the Lynnsport running track in King’s Lynn. Organisers are aiming to raise over £20,000 for various local causes.
Participants will receive full training before walking across hot embers. The evening also features fire performers, music, and food stalls. Gates open to the public at 7pm, with spectator entry costing £1, while children under 12 can enter for free. Those interested in taking part or supporting the event can find further details and registration information on the Lynn Priory Rotary Club website.

item.title: King’s Lynn man appears in court over alleged order breach
item.description:
📰 FENLAND ANGELS RADIO | LOCAL NEWS
King’s Lynn man appears in court over alleged order breach
A 29-year-old man from Fairstead has appeared at King’s Lynn Magistrates’ Court accused of breaching a community protection notice. Levi Coburn, of Anthony Nolan Road, is alleged to have been in possession of alcohol in a public place, which is prohibited under the terms of his order.
No plea was entered during Thursday’s hearing. Magistrates have adjourned the case until October 6, when it will be heard alongside other matters. Mr Coburn has been released on unconditional bail.
